pages.explanation_text: 6단계, 6페이지 단계입니다. 점 (x, y)를 x축 방향으로 p, y축 방향으로 q만큼 옮긴 새 점 (x', y')에 대하여 원래 좌표 x = x'-p, y = y'-q 가 f(x, y) = 0 을 만족하므로 도형의 방정식은 f(x-p, y-q) = 0 이 되며, 대칭이동은 수직이등분선과 중점 조건으로 부호가 반전되는 원리가 완성되는 단계입니다. 이때 꼭 기억해야 할 점은, 점의 평행이동은 (x+p, y+q)처럼 부호 그대로 더하지만, 도형의 방정식 f(x, y) = 0 의 평행이동은 원래 좌표 자리에 역변환 (x-p, y-q)를 대입하므로 마이너스 부호가 붙는다는 차이를 꼭 이해해야 합니다!

narrations.en: Step 6 (Page 6). narrations.ja: ステップ6、6ページステップです。点（x、y）をx軸方向にp、y軸方向にqだけ移動した新しい点（x'、y'）に対して、元の座標x = x'-p、y = y'-qがf（x、y）= 0を満たすため、図形の方程式はf（x-p、y-q）= 0となり、対称移動の前項加算値となる。ステップです。このとき必ず覚えておくべき点は、点の平行移動は(x+p, y+q)のように符号のまま加えるが、図形の方程式f(x, y) = 0の平行移動は元の座標桁に逆変換(x-p, y-q)を代入するのでマイナス符号が付くという違いを必ず理解しなければなりません！

narrations.en: Step 9 (Final Step): The visual proof is complete! Starting from the starting condition of 'When there are two points on y=(1/x), enlarge in the x-axis direction so that the two points are symmetrical to y=x', which explores the slope/intercept or parallel/symmetry movement in the equations of functions and shapes with the point (x, y) on the coordinate plane, which was the starting condition, draw a movement arrow from the representative point (vertex, origin, intercept) on the original graph to the new point (x', y') and x = x' - After going through the idea of substituting the p, y = y' - q relational expression into the original equation, it was clearly confirmed that the coordinate conversion rules and the graph's geometric movement principle lead to the conclusion that the equation of 'When there are two points on y=(1/x), expand in the x-axis direction so that the two points are symmetrical to y=x' and the graph properties are exactly the same. The key point to remember here is that the parallel movement of a point adds its sign as (x+p, y+q), but the parallel movement of the geometric equation f(x, y) = 0 substitutes the inverse transformation (x-p, y-q) in place of the original coordinates, so you must understand the difference. El punto clave a recordar aquí es que el movimiento paralelo de un punto agrega su signo como (x+p, y+q), pero el movimiento paralelo de la ecuación geométrica f(x, y) = 0 sustituye la transformación inversa (x-p, y-q) en lugar de las coordenadas originales, por lo que debes entender la diferencia. Enfin, posez une question plus profonde. Lors de la recherche des valeurs maximales et minimales d'une fonction quadratique dans un intervalle limité [alpha, bêta], pourquoi devrions-nous d'abord vérifier si non seulement les deux points limites mais aussi l'axe de symétrie (sommet x = p) sont inclus dans l'intervalle ?
